liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Let it Grow** (4 reviews): First-set Let It Grow is singled out as exceptional playing; A long, flowing Let It Grow closes the first set [10][12][13][16]
- **Eyes of the World** (3 reviews): Reviewer calls this a blistering version, among the best ever played; Eyes was exceptional, played within a strong first set [7][9][12]
- **Mississippi Half Step** (2 reviews): The opening Half-Step is described as a monster; Opens with a thumpy start, with a nice Garcia solo heading to the Rio Grande [12][17]
- **Estimated Prophet** (2 reviews): Estimated Prophet into Eyes is a major highlight of the show; Garcia takes a standout solo during Estimated Prophet [13][14]
- **Cassidy** (1 review): Standout version; listen for the descending jam just before they return to the song [17]
- **Brown Eyed Women** (1 review): Brown Eyed Women is an outstanding rendition [16]
- **Not Fade Away** (1 review): Not Fade Away has a long, subtle introduction [14]
- **Around & Around** (1 other source): Tape ran out partway through, so about 3:30 of Around & Around is missing [1]

## The recordings

- **gd1978-05-14.152506.aud.petrunis.flac2448** (recommended): audience recording; 19 songs; 169 min [1]. Said about its sound: Recorded from the upper arena; sound is distant, with small skips in Samson and Estimated [1]
- **gd1978-05-14.124932.mtx.dusborne.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 18 songs; 180 min; rated 5/5 by 8 [2]
- **gd1978-05-14.sbd.miller.108996.flac16**: soundboard; 18 songs; 179 min; rated 4.38/5 by 13 [3]
- **gd1978-05-14.akg-mono.friend.108840.flac1644**: audience recording; 18 songs; 179 min; rated 4.67/5 by 6 [4]. Said about its sound: This audience copy is cleaner than the other one posted [9]
- **gd78-05-14.sony.vernon.7639.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 18 songs; 173 min; rated 4.3/5 by 10 [5]. Said about its sound: Reviewer's audience recording sounds muted; they have known it from a cassette for over twenty years; Audience recording quality is quite listenable to the reviewer [6][7]

## Around the show

- Reviewer lived in Providence and says they met Jerry there [8]
- Garcia's voice is haggard but manageable; Bobby seems a bit off early [17]
- Reviewer ranks the Estimated Prophet into Eyes pairing among the best such combinations ever [7]
- Garcia's voice was often ragged in 1978, but his playing made up for it [9]
- At the time, one of the only 1978 shows with no soundboard in circulation [10]
- On these 1978 tours Garcia used a thick Wolf tone, giving jams a country-jazz flavor [16]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1978-05-14.152506.aud.petrunis.flac2448**: taped by Recording by Rich Petrunis.; transferred by Transferred by Andrew F. 05/2021; source: ono Sony hand-held recorder (model unknown) > TDK-AD (normal bias) cassettes. [1]. Also: Tapes shared by John and Rich Petrunis; a tape flip occurs near the end of Eyes [1]
- **gd1978-05-14.124932.mtx.dusborne.flac16**: transferred by Matrix by dusborne; source: 2 source matrix by dusborne; Soundboard (shinid:108996) SBD -> Cassette Master -> Dat -> CD; CD -> Samplitude Professional v10.1 -> FLAC; All Transfers and… [2]. Also: Matrix recording attributed to Dusborne, in FLAC with show information embedded in file headers [2]
- **gd1978-05-14.sbd.miller.108996.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master -> Dat -> CD [3]. Also: Soundboard transfer credited to Charlie, who is praised for the quality; Reviewer had assumed no soundboard existed; Charlie's release made it available [13][14]
- **gd1978-05-14.akg-mono.friend.108840.flac1644**: taped by Tim Friend; source: flac16 ;AUD: 1x AKG D200E (mono recording) > Sony TC-153SD > Maxell UD-XLII 90's. Recorded from lower arena riser, first section to left of stage, Section 110… [4]
- **gd78-05-14.sony.vernon.7639.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Unknown; transferred by Dale Shepherd; source: Audience Recording [5]

## Art and photos

- Poster by rirocks.net: [Grateful Dead 1978 05.14](https://rirocks.net/Band%20Articles/Grateful%20Dead%201978%2005.14%20-%20Prov.%20Civic%20Center.htm) [19]
- Poster by Mp3Caprice.com: [1978.05.14 - Providence Civic Center, Providence, RI](https://mp3caprice.com/release/1978-05-14-providence-civic-center-providence-ri-144829) [20]
